name: Love in Everblood!!!!
source:
So, you've been accepted to the Everblood Academy for Magic: How nice!

You go to the academy, hoping for a fresh new start. However, you come to realize that some things just never change. Whether it's something to do with you, or a figure from your past.

[From [url=https://liminace.itch.io/love-in-everblood-episode-1]itch.io[/url]]
